titulo: Bronchoscopic Removal of Aspergilloma in a 26‐Year‐Old Man

fig.label: FIGURE 1
fig.caption: Chest computed tomography performed before (A) and after (B) bronchoscopy. The prebronchoscopic image (A) demonstrates a large cavitary lesion containing an intra‐cavitary soft‐tissue mass with the characteristic ‘ball in hole’ and air‐crescent signs in the right upper lobe. The postprocedure image (B) shows marked cavity‐wall thinning at 18‐month follow‐up with no recurrence.
